notes.title: Trading cards + additional translations
notes.content:
Golfing Over It with Alva Majo now includes Stream trading cards and we have been adding support for multiple languages. The game is now available in:

- English
- Spanish
- German
- French
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Finnish
- Russian
- Korean
- Japanese
- Simplified Chinese

If you see any mistake, please report it on the forums so we can fix it.
Thank you.
